column5: Writes x, y, opacity and enable flags at the sprite offsets read by the draw routine. See sprite_place in src/native.c.
Loads an animation slot, rewinds on request and installs the active animation at offset 0x50. See src/native.c.
Writes a delayed event and its argument into the engine ring buffer. See engine_schedule in src/native.c.
The EAGL view setup and draw paths store and load this game engine pointer. See src/view_abi.h.
Builds four sprite corners, rotates each around the image center via 0x10014 (armv7), then writes position, texture coordinates and opacity.
Creates the engine base, installs its virtual table and loads the atlas from the input buffer; this is the callee that precedes installation of the game's overriding table.
The base destructor frees the atlas and OpenGL resources and emits the "Engine :: Dealloc." string. Both destructor variants reference it.
The bitmap font is embedded four bytes into its owner. Both font destructor variants pass that subobject to this empty base destructor.
Installs the base sprite vtable, sets opacity to one and clears the animation and activation flags.
Calls find_frames and initializes width, height and drawing insets. Recovered in src/native.c.
Copies the frame sequence, computes the frame interval from fps, and installs the animation at the given slot.
The table has two null Itanium ABI header words, followed by update, draw, both destructors and sprite_place, each pointing at its respective function start.
The controller's virtual table contains the game frame, touch callbacks, both destructor entries and score reporting in the order used by the engine.
The 48 bytes encoding 0,1,2,1 repeated three times occur exactly once in each slice's constant data.
The renderer's font initializer iterates over glyphs, measures advance widths and stores the overlap. See src/renderer.c.
Two zero header words precede the known complete and deleting game-font destructors.
The header precedes the button update, draw and destructor pointers. Update and draw are independently recovered in src/native.c.
The button class loads a named atlas region and copies both of its dimensions. See src/native.c.
Finds the atlas frame array and copies the first region's dimensions. See src/renderer.c.
Constructs the bird's two animations and installs its vtable. This function is independently byte-verified.
Bird reset is independently byte-verified and also called by the controller's reset and event handlers.
Loads the ready and tutorial images and creates their fade tween. See src/scene_overlays.c.
Loads text_game_over and constructs its tween. See src/scene_overlays.c.
Sets the button's x/y, active/visible flags and touch state. See button_place in src/native.c.
Activates the game-over overlay, starts its fade and queues the sound. See src/scene_overlays.c.
The game reset routine is independently byte-verified, including the background selection and button placement.
Configures mode, event and fade tween fields. See start_transition in src/native.c.
The flap impulse, animation selection and delayed wing event are independently verified from bird_flap in src/gameplay.c.
Checks the sprite's active flag and dispatches animation_tick for its current clip. This base update is recovered in src/native.c.
Native screen flash independently verified in matches/native.tsv.
Native screen shake independently verified in matches/native.tsv.
Native font positioning independently verified in matches/native.tsv.
Bitmap text rendering independently verified in matches/renderer.tsv.
